subject: Post-call recap: commercial targets & per-model volume ask
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Oana Ionescu <oana@corpxyz.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: commercial targets & per-model volume ask

Hi Oana — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can get a tight commercial preview over to procurement.

Call highlights (short):
- CorpXYZ wants to launch a support/knowledge assistant + search augmentation pilot in Q4.
- Expected steady-state monthly consumption after pilot: between 50M–140M input+output tokens (ballpark).
- Feature mix: generative chat for user-facing assistant, embedding-based search for retrieval, and a small rerank pipeline for top-K sorting.
- Primary constraint: blended TCO target for inference (incl. embeddings) ~ $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens.

What we need from you to firm pricing:
1) Quick confirmation of the expected monthly token volume (best single number or range).
2) Per-feature traffic split (estimated % of monthly tokens): chat / embeddings / rerank. If you don’t have precise numbers, a best-guess ratio is fine.
3) Typical prompt length for chat (avg tokens in prompt+response) and average embedding vector size or calls per session (if known).

Attached is a short pricing preview and a one-sheet usage worksheet (corpxyz-usage-worksheet.xlsx) you can fill. With the worksheet + model mix we’ll return:
- A blended $/1M token price range (hosted API) with sensitivity by model mix
- Recommended per-model routing (to balance latency and unit cost) and a cost impact table for quantization/batching knobs.

Proposed next steps:
- You fill and return the usage worksheet (15–30 min).
- We produce a short commercial preview and a sample canary config (3 business days).

If it helps, my suggestion (based on the call): assume a starting split of chat 68%, embeddings 27%, rerank 5% and monthly tokens = 85M as a working scenario; we’ll show +/- 30% sensitivity. Confirm or update when convenient.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up if the worksheet raises questions.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-preview.pdf (summary), corpxyz-usage-worksheet.xlsx (editable)

From: Oana Ionescu <oana@corpxyz.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: CorpXYZ Procurement <procurement@corpxyz.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 16:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: commercial targets & per-model volume ask

Thanks Dylan — useful recap. Quick answers inline: 

1) Monthly tokens: currently targeting 60M as our initial steady-state after pilot. We could scale to ~120M in 6–9 months if pilot metrics are strong.

2) Estimated split (best guess):
- Chat (assistant): 62%
- Embeddings (search + similarity): 33%
- Rerank (top-K scoring): 5%

3) Typical sizes:
- Chat average (prompt + response): ~420 tokens/session (we expect ~0.9 sessions/user/day for a cohort).
- Embeddings: ~2.5 embed calls/session, 512-token average input per embedding.
- Rerank calls: small per-session, average 12k tokens/month for rerank overall (rough).

Procurement loop: they asked for a blended target price. Their internal target is toward the low end of your range (~$800/1M) but they understand there will be per-model variance.

I’ll have procurement fill out the usage worksheet and share by tomorrow.

—Oana
Oana Ionescu
Head of Product, CorpXYZ
oana@corpxyz.com

Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: commercial targets & per-model volume ask

Thanks Oana — helpful detail. A couple of clarifying asks that will materially affect the blended price we return:

1) Embedding billing: are the embedding calls primarily for retrieval (one call -> many vectors) or do you expect frequent single-document embeddings? If you can indicate average vectors produced per call that’s ideal.

2) Chat latency & quality requirements: for the customer-facing assistant, do you need sub-300ms p50 generation latency or is 500–700ms acceptable? That changes preferred model family and unit cost.

Pricing notes (initial guidance we’ll use):
- We’ll construct a three-line model price (chat / embeddings / rerank) and then a blended $/1M tokens.
- Example working prices (illustrative only): chat $1,100 / 1M tokens; embeddings $260 / 1M tokens (equivalent basis); rerank $1,750 / 1M tokens. If CorpXYZ holds to $800 blended we will show tradeoffs (more aggressive batching/quantization, or routing a fraction to lower-cost model family).

If procurement returns the worksheet today, we can aim to send a commercial preview + routing recommendations by end of day Wednesday. Also copying Marissa to coordinate any contract/commit questions.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Adding a quick ops note on next steps from our side:

- Once procurement returns the filled worksheet I’ll prepare a one-page SOW + standard MSA addendum for pilot terms. If CorpXYZ wants committed discounts, we’ll outline reserved capacity vs hosted pricing and the breakpoint volumes.
- Dylan: can you confirm whether CorpXYZ expects to ingest any customer PII during the pilot? If yes, we’ll attach our data-handling addendum and SOC2 excerpt.
- Neha: please include two routing configs in the commercial preview: (A) latency-priority (higher-cost model mix), (B) cost-priority (more batching + quantized variants).

Oana — outstanding ask: earliest you can share the worksheet so we can keep to the Wednesday turnaround? Even partial data is fine and we’ll note assumptions.

Cheers,
